facts.activity_file: identifying every energy source for a task

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident during routine operation on CV-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CV-3100 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during routine operation while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 9 October 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on CV-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
